{{Quote|Yavin was both a beautiful and a terrible god to the Massassi. It lifted their eyes to the heavens, but made their hearts small and fearful.|Streen|<ref name="BTS" />}}
'''Yavin''' was the [[Deity/Legends|god]] of the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]], the warrior caste of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. He was represented by the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] that filled the skies of its [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. In the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] warriors, the [[Color/Legends|red]] god was awe-inspiring because of his all-dominating presence in the firmament. When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] ordered the Massassi to assemble [[Massassi Temple|monuments]], they found their own purpose in that command. In hopes of becoming like gods themselves, the Massassi built the temples in a vain attempt to reach their deity. Yavin was recorded in the [[Books of Massassi]], a collection of sacred texts.

==History==
{{Quote|They gathered these stones for the Sith in a vain effort to touch the face of their god.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="BTS" />}}
[[File:Massassi_architects.png|thumb|left|160px|The Massassi architects on Yavin 4]]
Around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] was defeated at a [[Second battle of Korriban|battle]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Sadow, accompanied by his remaining followers in a single [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crewed by [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors, went into self-imposed [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] on the remote [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], the fourth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]].<ref name="FOTSE5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]]</ref>

The Massassi who followed Naga Sadow to Yavin 4 came to regard Yavin Prime, the [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Planet/Legends|orb]] that filled the sky, as a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Deity/Legends|deity]] that was fascinating and terrifying at the same [[Time/Legends|time]]. Under Yavin's overwhelming presence above them, the warriors felt insignificant and frightened. When Sadow ordered his Massassi [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to clear the ground and build [[Massassi Temple|temples]] on Yavin 4, they took it as an opportunity to reach the heavenly realm of Yavin and achieve godly status themselves.<ref name="BTS" />

The religious experience of the Massassi with Yavin was described in the [[Books of Massassi]], a series of engraved tablets. [[Standard year/Legends|Millennia]] later, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum|Praxeum]] unearthed the Books from a collapsed underground chamber in the jungle. In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Streen]] translated the tablets and rediscovered the legend of Yavin.<ref name="BTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The red god Yavin was mentioned in ''[[Before the Storm]]'', a [[1996]] novel written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="BTS" />
